slides.line: The gel is engineered for precision.

slides.title: The lamp: position is power

points.text: Patient at 45°, lamp docked on the retractor.
Blue 460 nm light activates the green gel.

slides.notes: Light intensity falls with the square of distance.

slides.question: Cervical thirds still yellow — most likely cause?
slides.explanation: The barrier covered cervical enamel, so the gel never touched it.
